fw-poetics.title: Aristotle, Poetics (S. H. Butcher translation)
fw-poetics.notes: Action, characterization, recognition and causal plot; a historical theory, not universal law.

fw-leguin.title: Ursula K. Le Guin, The Carrier Bag Theory of Fiction (publisher overview)
fw-leguin.notes: Alternative narrative structures and value systems; publisher page is an overview, not full text.

fw-forster.title: E. M. Forster, Aspects of the Novel (1927): overview and themes
fw-forster.notes: Public overview of distinction between event and causal plot and flat/round character discussion. Consult original separately.

fw-worldbuilding.title: Worldbuilding: literary and fictional-setting practice (overview)
fw-worldbuilding.notes: General overview used for terminology, not a claim that a specific method is empirically validated.

fw-perspective.title: Perspective — Point of View, The Living Handbook of Narratology
fw-perspective.notes: Scholarly overview of voice versus focalization, focalization types, and point of view. Terminology from narrative theory, not a mandatory craft recipe.

fw-unreliability.title: Dan Shen, Unreliability, The Living Handbook of Narratology
fw-unreliability.notes: Scholarly account distinguishing failures of reporting, interpreting, and evaluating; discussion of Booth and subsequent classifications.

fw-forster-text.title: E. M. Forster, Aspects of the Novel (1927), full-text edition
fw-forster-text.notes: Primary text for the contrast between story chronology and plot causality; not a claim that one type of fiction is universally superior.

fw-modern-iowa.title: Iowa Writers Workshop: Our History
fw-modern-iowa.notes: Founding in 1936 and the development of workshops; not evidence for a single mandatory aesthetic.

fw-modern-programera.title: Mark McGurl, The Program Era: Postwar Fiction and the Rise of Creative Writing (2009)
fw-modern-programera.notes: Institutional impact of creative writing programs on postwar American fiction.

fw-modern-salesses.title: Matthew Salesses, Craft in the Real World: Rethinking Fiction Writing and Workshopping (2021)
fw-modern-salesses.notes: Challenges naturalized workshop values and asks about cultural expectations and voice.

fw-modern-saunders.title: George Saunders, A Swim in a Pond in the Rain (2021)
fw-modern-saunders.notes: Craft teaching through detailed analysis of readerly experience in short fiction.

fw-modern-carver.title: Raymond Carver, handbook chapter, De Gruyter (2022)

fw-modern-lish.title: The Poetics of the Sentence: Gordon Lish Literary Legacy (2015)
fw-modern-lish.notes: Lish editorial role in some American minimalist and dirty-realist work.

fw-modern-maximalism.title: Stefano Ercolino, The Maximalist Novel (2014)
fw-modern-maximalism.notes: Scholar proposed characteristics of maximalist novels; a critical taxonomy, not writers own manifesto.

fw-modern-barth.title: John Barth, The Literature of Exhaustion (1967), reprinted in Postmodernism and the Contemporary Novel
fw-modern-barth.notes: Barth discussion of exhausted possibilities; not a claim that fiction has ended.

fw-modern-postmodern-reader.title: Postmodernism and the Contemporary Novel: A Reader
fw-modern-postmodern-reader.notes: Historical context for fiction debates in the 1960s and 1970s.

fw-modern-oulipo.title: Dennis Duncan, The Oulipo and Modern Thought (2019)
fw-modern-oulipo.notes: History and implications of Oulipo and literary constraints.

fw-modern-oulipo-poetry.title: Poetry Foundation glossary, OuLiPo
fw-modern-oulipo-poetry.notes: Oulipo founding 1960 and exemplary procedural methods.

fw-modern-lanser.title: Susan Sniader Lanser, Fictions of Authority: Women Writers and Narrative Voice (1992)
fw-modern-lanser.notes: Feminist narratology and forms of narrative authority.

fw-modern-leguin-carrier.title: Ursula K Le Guin, The Carrier Bag Theory of Fiction (original 1980s essay)
fw-modern-leguin-carrier.notes: Alternatives to the heroic-killing narrative; care and carrying as story centers.

fw-modern-leguin-craft.title: Ursula K Le Guin, Steering the Craft (1998; revised 2015)
fw-modern-leguin-craft.notes: Narrative language, syntax, viewpoint, and collective workshop practice.

fw-modern-truby.title: John Truby, The Anatomy of Story (2007)
fw-modern-truby.notes: Author-specific 22-step story design focused on character, plot and moral argument.

fw-modern-brody.title: Jessica Brody, Save the Cat! Writes a Novel (2018)
fw-modern-brody.notes: 15-beat screenplay adaptation to novels; the universal-beats claim is an authors method assertion.

fw-modern-storygrid.title: Shawn Coyne, The Story Grid (2015): publisher history

fw-modern-autofiction.title: Hywel Dix, Autofiction, Oxford Research Encyclopedia of Literature (2022)
fw-modern-autofiction.notes: Origins of the term and unsettled generic identity.

fw-modern-sincerity.title: Adam Kelly, New Sincerity: American Fiction in the Neoliberal Age (2024)
fw-modern-sincerity.notes: Interpretative account of late postmodern American fiction; not a general recipe.

fw-modern-climate.title: Matt Bell, Climate Fictions: Future-Making Technologies (2021)
fw-modern-climate.notes: Climate fiction as broad and overlapping with speculative modes.

fw-modern-pratt-afrofuturism.title: Pratt Institute Libraries, Afrofuturism research guide
fw-modern-pratt-afrofuturism.notes: Historical coinage, prior cultural histories and evolving practices.

fw-modern-indigenous.title: Grace L Dillon (ed), Walking the Clouds: An Anthology of Indigenous Science Fiction (2012)
fw-modern-indigenous.notes: Indigenous science fiction forms and editorial framing.

fw-modern-speculative.title: Speculative Fiction, Oxford Research Encyclopedia of Literature
fw-modern-speculative.notes: Contested definition and history of speculative fiction.

fw-modern-montfort.title: Nick Montfort, Twisty Little Passages: An Approach to Interactive Fiction (2003)
fw-modern-montfort.notes: Parser-based IF history and its relation to literary art and games.

fw-modern-rettberg.title: Jill Walker Rettberg, Hypertext Fiction from 1987 to 1999 (2010)
fw-modern-rettberg.notes: Hypertext fiction community and Storyspace history distinct from text games.

fw-modern-twine.title: Twine, open-source interactive-narrative project
fw-modern-twine.notes: Twine nonlinear HTML story tooling, choices, passages and variables.

fw-modern-modernism.title: Poetry Foundation glossary, Modernism
fw-modern-modernism.notes: Broad cultural historical context and formal experiments in early twentieth-century fiction; no claim of one homogeneous movement.

fw-modern-magical-realism.title: Michael Bell, Garcia Marquez, magical realism and world literature (2010)

fw-hist-modernism-britishlibrary.title: British Library, Cities in modernist literature

fw-hist-modernism-cambridge.title: Pericles Lewis, The Cambridge Introduction to Modernism, prose fiction (2007)

fw-hist-modernism-humphrey.title: Robert Humphrey, Stream of Consciousness in the Modern Novel (1954)
fw-hist-modernism-humphrey.notes: Distinguishes approaches to fictional consciousness in Richardson, Joyce, Woolf, Faulkner.

fw-hist-boom-oxford.title: Juan E. De Castro, The Latin American Novel in the 1960s and Early 1970s: The Boom and Beyond
fw-hist-boom-oxford.notes: Boom authors, antecedents, noncanonical writers and political/publishing setting.

fw-hist-boom-cambridge.title: Consuelo Saizar, Constructing Hegemony: Latin American Boom and Spain/Mexico book industries (2020)
fw-hist-boom-cambridge.notes: Boom as literary and publishing phenomenon mediated by Barcelona, agents and global networks.

fw-hist-boom-agent.title: Dominique Lear, Carmen Balcells: The Agent of the Latin American Literary Boom (2024)

fw-hist-boom-coldwar.title: Deborah Cohn, The Latin American Literary Boom and U.S. Nationalism during the Cold War (2012)
fw-hist-boom-coldwar.notes: Cultural exchange networks, universities, publishers and Cold War relationships.

fw-hist-postcolonial-ngugi.title: Ngugi wa Thiong'o, Decolonising the Mind: The Politics of Language in African Literature (1986)

fw-hist-postcolonial-achebe.title: Simon Gikandi, Between Realism and Modernism: Chinua Achebe and the Making of African Literature
fw-hist-postcolonial-achebe.notes: Achebe on reshaping English for African self-fashioning and literature.

fw-hist-postcolonial-language.title: English and/in Africa: reflections on the language question (2024)

fw-hist-postcolonial-rhys.title: Cora Kaplan, The Empire at Home: Jean Rhys and Wide Sargasso Sea

fw-hist-postcolonial-rushdie.title: The Cambridge Introduction to the Novel: Salman Rushdie, Midnight's Children (1981)
fw-hist-postcolonial-rushdie.notes: National independence history and expansive self-questioning narration.

fw-hist-publishing-goldstone.title: Andrew Goldstone, Origins of the US Genre-Fiction System, 1890-1956 (2023)
fw-hist-publishing-goldstone.notes: Genre categories institutionalized via pulps, then paperbacks; prestige stratification.

fw-hist-publishing-loc.title: Library of Congress, Pulp Fiction Collection
fw-hist-publishing-loc.notes: Pulp categories, production, pay and circulation 1920s-1950s.

fw-hist-publishing-program.title: University of Iowa Libraries, The Program Era Project
fw-hist-publishing-program.notes: Historical documentation of institutional creative writing training.

fw-hist-publishing-king.title: Angela S. Allan, Stephen King, Incorporated (2021)
fw-hist-publishing-king.notes: Genre authorship and shifts in corporate publishing economics.

fw-hist-publishing-kdp.title: Amazon, A look back at 10 years of the Amazon Kindle

fw-debate-leguin-carrier.title: Ursula K. Le Guin, The Carrier Bag Theory of Fiction (1986; collection 1989)

fw-debate-gardner-review.title: Kirkus Reviews, On Moral Fiction (1978)

fw-debate-gardner-art.title: Kirkus Reviews, The Art of Fiction

fw-debate-barth-exhaustion.title: Johns Hopkins University Libraries, John Barth: Exhaustion and Other Essays

fw-debate-barth-funhouse.title: Johns Hopkins University Libraries, Lost and Found in the Funhouse: Introduction

fw-debate-barth-history.title: Johns Hopkins University Libraries, John Barth publication history
fw-debate-barth-history.notes: Dates major works and situates literary experimentation within a larger career.

fw-debate-saunders-book.title: Penguin Random House, A Swim in a Pond in the Rain by George Saunders (2021)

fw-debate-saunders-believer.title: The Believer, Interview with George Saunders (2021)

fw-debate-saunders-harvard.title: The Harvard Advocate, Interview with George Saunders (2021)
fw-debate-saunders-harvard.notes: Saunders discusses course and moral ambiguity in Russian stories.

fw-debate-saunders-mayday.title: Mayday, George Saunders on A Swim in a Pond in the Rain (2021)
fw-debate-saunders-mayday.notes: Saunders discusses revision, curiosity, and story as a reader-oriented exchange.

fw-debate-saunders-esquire.title: Esquire, George Saunders on Liberation Day (2022)
fw-debate-saunders-esquire.notes: Reflective comments about experimentation, revision, ambiguity and surprise.
